title: Chapter 380: The General Squad Goes Deep Behind Enemy Lines
content:
Chapter 380: The General Squad Goes Deep Behind Enemy Lines

At this time, one of them argued: "Who said I disagree, I just raised my hand a little slowly."

After that, he raised his hand.

Seeing this, the other people also raised their hands.

Wang Shuo knew that unifying everyone's ideas and pulling everyone together was the biggest test of this battle.

Afterwards, everyone put forward their own opinions, and Wang Shuo put the most popular proposals to everyone for voting in turn.

The progress of the meeting was advanced in a harmonious atmosphere.

In the end, the meeting reached several important resolutions.

First, everyone will pool resources and exchange several arrow towers first to strengthen the defense of the main base.

Second, all troops will be divided into two parts, one to clear the mother worms, and the other to defend the main base.

Third, send a team of about 10 warriors to the central forest to explore the situation and find out the movements of the red side.

After Wang Shuo exchanged the resources handed in by everyone for defense towers, he decided to take the warrior team to the central forest area for field exploration.

The defense towers exchanged from the base are advanced defense towers. A single attack can cause a lot of damage. For a junior general, it only takes five or six arrows to kill him.

As for the guards, they are naturally some melee infantry. These tasks are basically chosen by themselves.

So everyone did not resist when they executed them.

The reconnaissance mission that Wang Shuo performed was naturally the most dangerous. If you are not careful, you may encounter a large enemy force.

Wang Shuo saw that everyone was reluctant to go, so he had to go himself.

Following Wang Shuo, there was also Tian Liang. He was also a dragon beast unit. Like Wang Shuo's army, the cavalry had fast mobility, and the dragon beasts were also very powerful, which was suitable for this kind of reconnaissance work.

Leaving the base, Wang Shuo took 10 generals with him, and the other eight generals were summoned.

Only Wang Shuo and Tian Liang were generals who participated in the assessment.

The forest in the distance was a coniferous forest, and the ground was covered with pine needles.

The trees were tall, and each pine tree was only the size of a bowl.

But the jungle is very large. Looking far away, after 100 meters, you can only see dense trees.

Wang Shuo walked along the pine forest for a few hundred meters and then retreated.

He felt vaguely that if he continued to go deeper, he might be in danger.

Then, he circled along the grove.

This circle took nearly two hours. The area of the forest was really large.

Just near the edge of the red base, Wang Shuo found traces of activities of people in the enemy camp.

They were divided into small groups and were also exploring in the direction of the earth mother worm.

Wang Shuo ambushed in the original place and waited for a long time.

Only then did he realize that these people were probably people who did not obey orders.

Wang Shuo thought about it, came to the front of what they were about to explore, discarded some exchanged weapons and arrows, and even deliberately placed a Shura Order in a conspicuous place to disguise this place as a resource point.

Then he deliberately made a noise to attract several nearby enemy teams.

If it could cause internal fighting on the other side, it would naturally be great.

If there is no fighting, as long as someone leaks this news, it may attract more people to explore here, thus dispersing the enemy's forces.

This is just a casual move.

The more people in the opponent's camp who do not act in unison with the main force, the more advantageous it is for oneself.

Afterwards, Wang Shuo went deep into the red camp and searched for the location of the opponent's main base.

But he did not dare to go too deep, fearing that he would be surrounded by the enemy.

But how could he not be discovered by the enemy if he went deep behind the enemy's back? Although Wang Shuo was careful enough, he was still discovered by the enemy half an hour later.
